description: This file defines the LinkMetadata data structure and associated functions for handling link metadata, including OpenGraph data and images, in the Mattermost project.

classes.name: LinkMetadata
classes.description: Represents metadata about a link, including URL, timestamp, type, and associated data such as images or OpenGraph info.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Computes and sets the hash for the LinkMetadata before saving.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the LinkMetadata object for correctness.

methods.name: DeserializeDataToConcreteType
methods.description: Converts the Data field from JSON into its proper structured type.

methods.name: FloorToNearestHour
methods.description: Rounds a timestamp in milliseconds down to the previous hour in UTC.

methods.name: isRoundedToNearestHour
methods.description: Checks if a timestamp is rounded to the nearest hour.

methods.name: GenerateLinkMetadataHash
methods.description: Creates a hash based on URL and timestamp for database key purposes.
